faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our refurbished printers and Eco Inks subscriptions.
faqPage.q1: Are the printers new or refurbished?
faqPage.a1: Our printers are professionally refurbished HP LaserJet units. Each one is fully inspected, cleaned, and restored to factory specifications. We specialize in HP because parts are widely available and the printers are extremely user-friendly.
faqPage.q2: What happens if the printer breaks?
faqPage.a2: We offer full maintenance and support. If your printer malfunctions, our local support team will repair or replace it entirely free of charge, ensuring zero downtime for your business.
faqPage.q3: Am I locked into a long-term contract?
faqPage.a3: No. Our model is built on flexibility. We offer transparent, straightforward agreements without restrictive lock-in clauses.
faqPage.q4: How do I order more ink?
faqPage.a4: Our systems can optionally monitor ink levels and auto-ship replacements, or you can order via your dedicated account manager. Delivery is fast and localized.
faqPage.a5: Yes. Our toner uses bio-derived elements and zero volatile organic compounds (VOCs). We also operate a closed-loop recycling program for cartridges.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.subtitle: Last updated: June 9, 2026
privacyPage.introduction: Future Next Gen ('FNG', 'we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share personal data in connection with our website (fngtradingco.com) and our Sustainable Printing services in Saudi Arabia, in compliance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
privacyPage.section1Desc: We collect information you provide directly to us when requesting a refurbished printer, subscribing to Eco Inks, or contacting us. This includes your name, company name, phone number, email address, city, and printing preferences.
privacyPage.section2Desc: We process your personal data to: provide and maintain our services, respond to inquiries, arrange delivery and installation, manage your Eco Inks subscription, and comply with regulatory requirements under KSA laws.
privacyPage.section3Desc: We do not sell your personal data. Your data is stored securely and processed in accordance with the security standards set out by the KSA authorities. We only share data with service providers who assist in delivery, technical maintenance, or payment processing.
privacyPage.section4Desc: Under the Saudi PDPL, you have the right to access, correct, destroy, or restrict the processing of your personal data. You may contact us at Support@fngtradingco.com to exercise these rights at any time.

termsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
termsPage.subtitle: Last updated: June 9, 2026
termsPage.introduction: Welcome to fngtradingco.com. By accessing our website and using our Sustainable Printing services, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following Terms & Conditions. Please read them carefully.
termsPage.section1Desc: Under our B2B model, FNG provides certified refurbished HP LaserJet printers to eligible Saudi businesses. The printers remain the property of Future Next Gen at all times. Deployment is subject to a paid Eco Inks toner subscription.
termsPage.section2Desc: By enrolling in the program, you agree to purchase and use only FNG Eco Inks or Premium compatible toners for the deployed printers. Using third-party generic toners is a violation of the agreement and voids the free maintenance and support service.
termsPage.section3Desc: FNG provides free maintenance, repair, and replacement support for all deployed printers, provided the business is actively using our toners. Maintenance requests are responded to within 48 hours in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Al Madinah.
termsPage.section4Desc: Our B2B agreements are flexible with no restrictive lock-in clauses. Either party may terminate the agreement by providing 30 days' written notice, upon which FNG will collect the deployed printer equipment.
